title: Brooks Opens its Special Edition Saddle Vault with Unearthed Collection
content:
In 2025, the team at Brooks Unearthed an assortment of leather saddle tops in its factory from a variety of manufacturing processes and periods. Rather than see them go to waste, the UK saddle makers made them into a small, vibrant, limited release batch of leather saddles.

Each Unearthed saddle is the result of a small discovery moment inside the brand’s Smethwick factory: leather tops produced over years and decades of saddle-making, each one bearing the character of the period and technique that shaped it. Rather than discard or recycle these unique pieces, Brooks’ craftspeople carefully built each one into a finished saddle, hand-finished to the same Brooks standards that define every model it makes.

Check it out at Brooks Unearthed.
